claude.label: Claude Code
claude.notes: Fresh Windows Claude Code in workspaces.default. Prereq: claude on PATH + signed in. Resume: vibelaunch claude-resume. Extra agent flags: vibelaunch claude -- <flags> or presets.local.json args. Fail: command not found -> install Claude Code / open a fresh shell.

claude-resume.label: Claude Code (resume)
claude-resume.notes: Resume last Claude Code session (-c) and auto-approve tools (--dangerously-skip-permissions). Same cwd as claude. Prereq: prior session + claude on PATH. Fail: nothing to resume -> use claude first. To keep permission prompts, override args in presets.local.json.

codex.label: Codex (config cwd)
codex.notes: Interactive Windows Codex TUI at config cwd (defaults.json / defaults.local.json cwd). Prereq: codex on PATH + auth. Fail: instant exit -> stale PATH; open a new terminal or run vibelaunch preflight.

codex-workspace.label: Codex -> example workspace
codex-workspace.notes: Windows Codex in workspaces.default (set in defaults.local.json). Prereq: path exists + codex on PATH. Fail: bad cwd -> fix workspaces.default; instant exit -> PATH (see codex / preflight).

cmd-scroll-test.label: cmd.exe scrollback test
cmd-scroll-test.notes: Diagnostic cmd.exe only (not an agent) for keypad/PC scroll depth. At prompt: for /L %i in (1,1,100) do @echo line %i - then scroll. Pair with --cols/--rows or GUI PTY size (rows = history depth).

hermes-vk.label: Hermes (VibeKeys)
hermes-vk.notes: Hermes chat + vibekeys-hermes; sets HERMES_VIBEKEYS_SESSION=1. Auto: WSL if wsl.enabled + hermes in WSL, else Windows PATH. Override: vibelaunch hermes wsl | vibelaunch hermes windows. Prereq WSL: wsl.user + hermes in distro. Fail: blank wsl.user -> setup-wsl-remote.ps1; Windows fallback may lack your WSL auth.

hermes-vk-wsl.label: Hermes (VibeKeys, WSL)
hermes-vk-wsl.notes: Force WSL Hermes (ignores Windows PATH hermes). Topology: Windows vibetty -> wsl.exe -> hermes. Prereq: wsl.user + hermes in that distro. Fail: placeholder wsl.user -> setup-wsl-remote.ps1; hermes not found -> install/auth in WSL.

hermes-vk-win.label: Hermes (VibeKeys, Windows)
hermes-vk-win.notes: Force native Windows Hermes only (no WSL). Prereq: Windows hermes on PATH + separate Windows auth. Expected limitation if your live Hermes stack is WSL-only - use hermes-vk-wsl / hermes-vk instead.

hermes-codex-workspace.label: Hermes + Codex model (WSL)
hermes-codex-workspace.notes: WSL Hermes + vibekeys-hermes with model pin -m openai-codex/gpt-5.4 at spawn (override in presets.local.json or /model in chat). Prereq: WSL hermes + Codex provider auth in WSL. Fail: model/provider errors -> hermes auth or /model; wsl.user -> setup-wsl-remote.ps1.

hermes-codex-workspace-win.label: Hermes + Codex model (Windows)
spawn: set HERMES_VIBEKEYS_SESSION=1&& hermes chat --skills vibekeys-hermes -m openai-codex/gpt-5.4
hermes-codex-workspace-win.notes: Windows Hermes with the same Codex model pin. Prereq: Windows hermes on PATH + Windows Codex/provider auth (separate from WSL). Expected limitation when only WSL Hermes is provisioned - prefer hermes-codex-workspace.

openclaw-vk.label: OpenClaw TUI (vibekeys session)
openclaw-vk.notes: WSL-only OpenClaw TUI with --session vibekeys (keypad-friendly; less main-session heartbeat spam). Topology: Windows vibetty -> wsl.exe -> openclaw. Prereq: wsl.user, openclaw in WSL, gateway up. Fail: connection refused -> start OpenClaw gateway (often :18789).

openclaw-tui.label: OpenClaw TUI (main session)
openclaw-tui.notes: WSL OpenClaw gateway main session (no --session). Prefer openclaw-vk for keypad; main can spam heartbeat/status on small screens. Same WSL/gateway prereqs as openclaw-vk.

openclaw-cursor-workspace.label: OpenClaw -> Cursor ACP
openclaw-cursor-workspace.notes: WSL-only OpenClaw ACP harness: TUI --message '/acp spawn cursor --cwd {{workspaces.default-wsl}} --mode persistent'. Prereq: gateway up, acpx enabled, cursor in acp.allowedAgents, Cursor agent acp on WSL PATH, workspaces.default-wsl exists. Verify: openclaw tui --message '/acp doctor'. Fail: policy/allowlist -> docs/OPENCLAW_ACP.md; auth -> Cursor agent login in WSL. Not Windows-native.

openclaw-codex-workspace.label: OpenClaw -> Codex ACP
openclaw-codex-workspace.notes: WSL-only OpenClaw ACP harness id codex (explicit ACP path; native /codex is separate). Prereq: acpx + codex in acp.allowedAgents + WSL 'codex login'. Fail: 'not allowed by policy' -> allowlist codex; 401 -> codex login in WSL (Windows auth does not apply). See docs/OPENCLAW_ACP.md.

hermes-acp-cursor.label: Hermes -> Cursor ACP (drop-in)
hermes-acp-cursor.notes: WSL Hermes ACP *client* drop-in to live Cursor (not OpenClaw /acp). Shell: type prompts; exit quits. Prereq: python3, ~/bin/hermes-acp-client.py (from tools/), Cursor Pro agent auth. Fail: missing client -> copy tools/hermes-acp-client.py; auth -> agent login. See docs/HERMES_ACP_CLIENT.md.

hermes-acp-claude.label: Hermes -> Claude Code ACP (drop-in)
hermes-acp-claude.notes: WSL drop-in to Claude Code via npx @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp. Prereq: Node, Claude Pro auth, ~/bin/hermes-acp-client.py. Fail: node/npx missing; auth -> claude login. See docs/HERMES_ACP_CLIENT.md.

hermes-acp-codex.label: Hermes -> Codex ACP (drop-in)
hermes-acp-codex.notes: WSL drop-in to Codex via npx @zed-industries/codex-acp. Prereq: Node, codex login, ~/bin/hermes-acp-client.py. Fail: 401/token_invalidated -> re-run codex login (account-wide, not adapter). See docs/HERMES_ACP_CLIENT.md.
